parameters.lower_description: packed brown dirt path, warm earthy tones, NES-era retro pixel art, few colors
parameters.upper_description: short green grass meadow, warm earthy tones, NES-era retro pixel art, few colors

generation.generations: 3 or 4: this tileset and the rejected one below were charged 7 together, read from the balance; the receipt does not split them.

files.tileset.json: PixelLab's metadata for the sheet: each tile's corners (NW, NE, SW, SE as lower or upper) and its bounding_box on the sheet. Whatever draws the ground picks each tile by its four corners and cuts it out by its bounding_box, never by its wang_N name or original_position.

rejectedTags: Tilesets cannot be tagged in PixelLab; this list is how the rejects are found.

rejected.why: The same descriptions with transition_size 0: lime grass and salmon dirt, brighter than the hero sets.

chosenBy: The owner, 2026-10-19, in a 320×180 camp mock-up at 4× with kept hero sets (art/mockups/first-camp-4x.png).
